_comment: Production build config - api.docwellness.fit (real prod, Oracle VPS) + prod-environment SDK keys. Same values .github/workflows/build-release-aab.yml passes for the Play Store release. Running the app with this locally talks to the REAL production backend and its patients' data - use scripts/run-dev.ps1 for everyday work. Safe to commit: Sentry DSNs and PostHog project API keys are designed to be public/client-embeddable; this app no longer talks to Supabase directly so there is no Supabase key here. Real secrets never belong in a Flutter dart-define.
